defs.def: violent physical action used to obtain or achieve sth 武力；暴力
the physical strength of sth that is shown as it hits sth else 力；力量

ex.s: In tai chi, the dan tian is your qi core and qi in Chinese means life force.
ex.t: 在太极拳中，丹田是你的气之核心，而“气”在中文里意为生命力。

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分，我阐述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，先审视那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，接着详细讨论数字极简主义理念。

ex.s: It has been an enormously positive force." Watched by millions, the ending to the race has divided opinions: should the brothers have been disqualified or highly praised for their actions?
ex.t: “它一直是一股极为积极的力量。”在数百万人的注视下，比赛结局引发了分歧：兄弟俩的行为应该被取消资格，还是受到高度赞扬？

ex.s: It has been an enormously positive force.” We could also say Although the brothers sometimes argue over "stupid things", Alistair thinks that it is a good thing to have a brother.
ex.t: 这是一股非常积极的力量。我们也可以说，虽然兄弟俩有时会为“愚蠢的事情”而争吵，但阿利斯泰尔认为有一个兄弟是件好事。

ex.s: He explains that in his entire life, his brother always tries to beat him at everything he does and that it has been a very positive force.
ex.t: 他解释说，在他的一生中，他的哥哥总是试图在他做的每件事上打败他，这成为了一股非常积极的力量。

ex.s: The force required to break the pancake was less than 1% of the trunk’s weight (about 100kg).
ex.t: 掰开那块“煎饼”所需的力小于树干重量（约100公斤）的1%。

ex.s: Disruption can be a force for good.
ex.t: 颠覆也可以是一种向善的力量。

ex.s: Humility should be a driving force for human progress.
ex.t: 谦逊应当成为人类进步的驱动力。

ex.s: Declining birth rate is a major problem in many developing regions too, which might cause catastrophic global shortages of work force within a few decades.
ex.t: 出生率下降在许多发展中地区也是一个重大问题，可能在几十年内导致全球劳动力的灾难性短缺。

ex.s: A great decline in young work force is likely to occur in China, for instance.
ex.t: 例如，中国很可能出现年轻劳动力的大幅减少。

ex.s: In 2030, a sixth of the country’s potential work force could be totally uneducated.
ex.t: 到2030年，该国潜在劳动力中可能有六分之一完全未受教育。

defs.def: the strong effect or influence of sth 强大效力；巨大影响

ex.s: The keyboard could offer a strong layer of security by analyzing things like the force of a user's typing and the time between key presses.
ex.t: 键盘可以通过分析诸如用户敲击的力度和按键间隔等，提供一层强大的安全性。

ex.s: And it’s especially important for those new to the work force.
ex.t: 对年轻人来说，信息技术技能将在未来发挥越来越重要的作用。

defs.def: a person or thing that has a lot of power or influence 力量大的人（或事物）；影响大的人（或事物）

ex.s: “Impetuous has two definitions: rushing with great force or violence; acting suddenly, with little thought. ”
ex.t: “Impetuous有两个释义：以巨大的力量或暴力冲撞；突然行动，欠思考。”

defs.def: the authority of sth 权力；效力
a group of people who have been organized for a particular purpose （为某目的组织起来的）一群人

ex.s: Benjamin was forced to admit what he had been doing.
ex.t: 本杰明被迫承认他一直在做的事情。

defs.def: a group of people who have been trained to protect other people, usually by using weapons 武装部队；部队
the army, navy and air force 兵力，武装力量（陆海空三军）
the weapons and soldiers that an army, etc. has, considered as things that may be used 武装力量

ex.s: I tell my mom that if we’re forced eat things, we may become ill.
ex.t: 我告诉妈妈如果我们被迫吃东西，我们可能会生病。

defs.def: the police force 警察部门
an effect that causes things to move in a particular way 力
a unit for measuring the strength of the wind 风力；风力等级
in large numbers 人
being used 法律、规则等
to make sb do sth that they do not want to do 强迫，迫使（某人做某事）

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，他为什么突然强迫我去做一件我肯定会失败的事呢？

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，他为什么突然强迫我去做一件我肯定会失败的事呢？

ex.s: We will probably have to force ourselves to waken our curiosity and discontent and keep them awake.
ex.t: 我们可能不得不强迫自己唤醒我们的好奇心和不满，并让它们保持清醒。

ex.s: I woke up most mornings with a dull, grey feeling as I forced myself out of bed to start the day.
ex.t: 大多数早晨我醒来时都带着一种沉闷、灰暗的感觉，强迫自己起床开始新的一天。

ex.s: Companies could be forced to consumers what information they hold and how many money they make form it.
ex.t: 公司可能被迫向消费者披露它们持有哪些信息以及从中获利多少。

ex.s: Somehow, I forced my finger to press the button.
ex.t: 不知怎的，我强迫自己的手指按下按钮。

ex.s: I love to photograph the rising sun, so I force myself into the natural world by waking early each day.
ex.t: 我喜欢拍摄日出，所以我强迫自己每天早起进入大自然。

defs.def: to use physical strength to move sb/sth into a particular position 用力，强行（把 … 移动）

ex.s: forcing patients into a state of deep sleep
ex.t: 把患者逼入深度睡眠状态

ex.s: Eventually, my brother decided to leave rather than force the issue.
ex.t: 最终，我弟弟决定离开，而不是强求。

defs.def: to make sth happen, especially before other people are ready 使发生（尤指趁他人尚未准备）
to make yourself smile, laugh, etc. rather than doing it naturally 强作笑颜；强装欢笑

ex.s: I forced a smile, unsure how to respond further.
ex.t: 我勉强挤出笑容，不知该如何进一步回应。

defs.def: to make fruit, plants, etc. grow or develop faster than normal by keeping them in special conditions 人工催长；加速（水果、植物等）生长；催熟
to run very fast in a race in order to make the other people taking part run faster 迫使（赛跑对手）加速
to make sb do sth faster than they want to 迫使（某人）加快速度

ex.s: The Disruptor forces change; the clean-up is somebody else’s problem.
ex.t: 这种态度最好概括为"快速行动，打破常规"。

defs.def: to make yourself eat or drink sth that you do not really want 强迫咽下（食物或饮料）

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月份以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士不等的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

defs.def: to make a plane, etc. land, especially by threatening to attack it 迫使（飞机等）降落

chunks.cn: 积极的力量 / 生活力量 / 伟大的力量
